tokenName: Securities Exchange Community Grain Receipt Token

description: Securities Exchange lists tokenised warehouse receipts from smallholder farmers and rural cooperatives in UAE. Minimum lot size is 1 bag of produce.
regulatoryFramework: UAE Warehouse Receipts Act; Securities Exchange Commodity Listing Rules
